name: Weft
rationale: The horizontal threads in weaving that bind the vertical warp into fabric. Metaphor for how Converge weaves independent agent tasks into a verified whole.
why_creative: Four letters, concrete craft term, implies structure and binding without saying orchestration. Strong CLI feel.
risk: May be unfamiliar to non-craft audiences, but pronunciation is clear.

name: Cadence
rationale: Musical term for rhythmic flow and resolution. Maps to Converge's loop-until-checks-pass rhythm and the feeling of work reaching completion.
why_creative: Premium developer brand (Cadence Design Systems), implies reliable rhythm and resolution, not chaotic flow.
risk: Existing enterprise software brand, though in different domain (EDA tools).

name: Anvil
rationale: The foundational tool where metal is shaped through repeated strikes. Metaphor for the runtime that hammers tasks until checks pass.
why_creative: Concrete, durable, implies strength and precision. Strong single-syllable feel for CLI.
risk: Could feel heavy or industrial rather than modern/fast.

name: Bearing
rationale: Navigation term for precise direction. Converge gives teams a bearing through complex AI work with DAG-based execution.
why_creative: Technical precision metaphor, implies direction and confidence, avoids flow/agent clichés.
risk: Multiple meanings (direction, mechanical part, endurance) could dilute focus.

name: Lattice
rationale: Mathematical structure of interconnected nodes. Converge compiles playbooks into a lattice of verified tasks.
why_creative: Graph metaphor without saying graph, implies elegant structure and mathematical rigor.
risk: Existing semiconductor company (Lattice Semi), may feel slightly abstract.

name: Keystone
rationale: The central stone in an arch that locks all other pieces in place. Converge is the keystone that makes AI agent work reliable.
why_creative: Architectural metaphor for structural integrity and the piece that makes everything hold.
risk: Longer (8 letters), existing pipeline product (Keystone in OpenStack).

name: Tally
rationale: A verified count or record. Converge tallies task completion through shell-command checks, not vibes.
why_creative: Short, concrete, implies accountability and verified counting. Strong CLI command feel.
risk: Could feel accounting-focused rather than developer-tool focused.

name: Span
rationale: The distance or structure that bridges two points. Converge spans from chaotic prompts to verified outputs.
why_creative: Four letters, architectural and graph-theory meanings, implies bridging and coverage.
risk: Very short and broad, may be hard to own in search/trademark.

name: Temper
rationale: The process of heating and cooling metal to achieve precise strength. Converge tempers AI output through iterative checks.
why_creative: Craft metaphor for refinement through process, implies precision and durability.
risk: Multiple meanings (mood, metal process) could create confusion.

name: Rhumb
rationale: A navigation line of constant bearing. Converge provides a constant bearing through AI work with playbook-based execution.
why_creative: Rare, ownable, technical navigation term. Five letters, distinctive sound.
risk: Unfamiliar word, pronunciation not obvious from spelling.

name: Quire
rationale: A set of folded sheets forming part of a book. Converge assembles independent task outputs into a complete, bound artifact.
why_creative: Publishing metaphor for assembled verified work, distinctive and ownable.
risk: Archaic term, may feel too literary for developer tools.

name: Dovetail
rationale: A precise woodworking joint where pieces interlock perfectly. Converge dovetails agent tasks into verified execution.
why_creative: Craft metaphor for precision fit and interlocking parts, implies quality and care.
risk: Longer (8 letters), verb form means 'to fit together' which is positive but may feel descriptive.

name: Attest
rationale: To provide proof or evidence. Converge attests to task completion through shell-command verification.
why_creative: Verification language that maps directly to check-based execution, implies trust and proof.
risk: Could feel formal/legal rather than developer-friendly.

name: Spline
rationale: A flexible strip used in drafting to draw smooth curves, or a ridge that fits into a groove. Converge splines together agent tasks.
why_creative: Technical term with both craft and mathematical meanings, implies smooth connection.
risk: May feel too technical/CAD-specific, existing graphics term.

name: Folio
rationale: A sheet of paper folded once, or a collection of works. Converge produces a folio of verified task outputs.
why_creative: Publishing metaphor for collected verified work, implies portfolio and completeness.
risk: May feel too publishing-specific, existing design/portfolio connotations.
